metrics.profile_summary: Dynamic Digital Marketing Specialist with 7 years of experience specializing in paid search, SEO, lead generation, and product marketing. Proven track record of growing organic traffic and leveraging analytics for data-driven decision-making.

education.degree: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) in Marketing

education.institution: Govt. Comprehensive Higher Sec School, Karachi

experience.description: Develops and executes comprehensive digital marketing strategies, overseeing SEO, PPC, social media, and email marketing. Utilizes Google Analytics for conversion rate optimization and budget management.
Implemented SEO strategies and managed PPC campaigns to achieve ROI. Conducted keyword research using Ahrefs and Google Keyword Planner to target specific audiences.
Led processes to expand retail opportunities and implemented SEO best practices to improve web presence.
Supported strategic planning, market research, and administrative tasks. Assisted in creating promotional materials and social media campaigns.
